csrf.description: Synchronizer token from the JavaScript-readable CSRF cookie. Unsafe methods also need an exact Origin (or, without one, a Referer on the public origin).

session.description: Opaque HttpOnly session cookie set by the login callback (named policyops_session_local on plain-HTTP local origins).
session.name: __Host-policyops_session
